At Allseas, we enable the development of groundbreaking offshore solutions that support the energy transition. Our success depends on making informed decisions, managing resources effectively, and continuously improving the way we operate.
 

Within Business Finance, we act as trusted partners to the business, enabling sustainable performance through cost transparency, financial planning, data-driven insights, and strong financial governance. We challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and support the business in turning strategy into results.
 

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a 
Finance Business Partner for Crewing.
 

 
 

Your role
 

 
 

As Finance Business Partner for Crewing, you will support one of the most critical functions within Allseas: ensuring our vessels are staffed with the right people, at the right time, and at the right cost.
 

You will partner closely with Crewing, Vessel Management, Human Resources, and Operations leadership, providing financial insight and decision support that enables effective workforce planning, cost management, and operational performance.
 

You will act as a trusted advisor, helping stakeholders understand financial impacts, challenge assumptions, evaluate opportunities, and drive continuous improvement.
 

Key responsibilities include:
 

Business Partnering & Decision Support
 
 

• Partner with Crewing and Vessel Management to support operational and strategic decision-making. 

• Develop business cases, scenario analyses, and actionable recommendations. 

• Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and resource utilization. 

• Challenge assumptions and support management in making informed decisions.  

Financial Planning & Performance Management
 
 

• Lead budgeting and forecasting activities. 

• Monitor financial performance and analyse variances against budget and forecast. 

• Provide timely insights into cost drivers, trends, opportunities, and risks.  

Cost Transparency & Reporting
 
 

• Deliver reliable and business-relevant financial reporting. 

• Develop and enhance management dashboards and performance analyses.  

Process Improvement & Financial Governance
 
 

• Safeguard data integrity and compliance with financial standards and policies. 

• Identify and implement improvements in end-to-end business processes, systems (SAP, PowerBI) 

You are curious, analytical, and eager to understand how the business operates. You enjoy working with stakeholders across different disciplines and can translate complex data into practical business insights.
 

You also have the confidence to challenge existing ways of working and help drive positive change.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. 

• 5 years of experience in Business Finance, Financial Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering. 

• Experience in a project-driven, engineering, offshore, maritime, or international environment is an advantage.

lobal SAP Process Owner, Order Fulfillment

 

Company Overview:

The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, produces and distributes an extensive range of imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications.

Agfa Healthcare IT is a leading provider of advanced healthcare IT solutions, offering a range of software and services that help healthcare organizations improve clinical workflows, enhance patient care, and optimize operational efficiency. Working closely with business stakeholders and external IT partners, you will ensure that processes are effectively integrated into our global SAP landscape and support business transformation, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction. To strengthen its local IT presence in Belgium, our client is looking for a service-oriented IT professional who enjoys working in a collaborative and multicultural environment. The organisation promotes knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and professional development while offering employees the opportunity to work closely with both local and international teams.

As a Service Desk Analyst / IT Support Engineer (L1/L2), your responsibilities will include:

• Providing first and second-line IT support to end users.

• Troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and Microsoft 365-related issues.

About Corlutions
 

Corlutions is a digitalization partner for small and medium-sized enterprises, specializing in Odoo-based solutions that help organizations reduce costs and increase revenue. We work closely with clients across sectors like manufacturing, construction, wholesale, and finance — always living by our principle: "Together is better."
 

 
 

What is a Business Analyst at Corlutions?
 

As a Business Analyst, your mission is to help our clients optimize their business processes through smart, well-implemented software — primarily Odoo and Business Intelligence. You'll gather and document business requirements, and translate them into clear functional specifications that guide every project.
 

You'll work closely with clients to ensure optimal use of Odoo apps such as Accounting, Point of Sales, eCommerce, Manufacturing, Inventory, Projects, Websites, Sales and more. By diving into your client's needs and processes, and providing personalized training, you'll become the go-to expert for their management solutions.
 

In your first weeks, you'll get comprehensive training before jumping into your first projects — always with the support of your mentor and colleagues. As you gain experience, you'll gain autonomy too. Collaboration stays key throughout: you'll be in regular contact with clients, developers, and the internal team.
 

 
 

Responsibilities
 

Project Implementation (80%)
 
 

• Gain the trust of your customers 

• Analyse needs, gather and document requirements, and suggest and implement solutions (configuration, development and testing) 

• Provide training 

• Follow-up and communication about ongoing tasks  

Internal improvement (20%)
 
 

• Feedback to the internal team 

• Mentoring and training 

• Feedback for improvement  

Optional: support other domains such as marketing, HR and accounting at Corlutions (impacts the % split above).
